release_notes: Tachyon AIO v0.45.11 adds live Member Announcements. Standard members now receive an ANNOUNCEMENTS surface in the exact Top/Classic and Sidebar footprint otherwise reserved for Owner Vault, while owner/admin/support sessions retain the privileged Owner Vault. The member surface shows the newest active announcement, opens a current announcement history center when clicked and discovers newly published messages through Tachyon's existing signed member authority policy every 5 seconds, displaying a non-blocking live popup without requiring an app restart. The existing owner broadcast publisher is reused and presented as Member Announcements with Send Live; no reusable admin credential or unauthenticated messaging endpoint is exposed to the WebView. The release also hardens privilege visibility, newest-first ordering, HTML escaping and background DOM behavior so standard keys cannot inherit the Owner Vault launcher and the announcement runtime avoids unnecessary document-wide mutation work. The exact final main build passed Architecture Guard, Linux Release Preflight, Windows Consumer E2E, CodeQL, Private Core CI, real Chromium E2E and the 120-task browser soak.
